title: Runners report why an implement session ended

story.i_want_to: the runner to report why a session ended and loopctl to act on the reason
story.so_that: a budget kill stops for a human instead of being retried, and a crash releases the story at once

rationale: Control learns that a session died only through lease expiry, so a wall-clock kill, a turn-budget kill, an exhausted subscription and a crash look identical and would each be retried. The runner's report cannot be allowed to make a story terminal: failed has no way out, and the stage machine withholds it from runners for that reason. So a reported budget kill escalates, a crash releases now instead of at lease expiry, and exhaustion releases without counting against the retry ceiling.

acceptance_criteria.description: The contract accepts an optional session_ended message {dispatch_id, claim_epoch, reason}, reason in completed | wall_clock_exceeded | max_turns_exceeded | usage_exhausted | crashed; any other reason is refused invalid_payload.

session_ended is recorded once per dispatch; a byte-identical resend is answered ok with the current stage row before any epoch check, and a different reason for the same dispatch is refused already_recorded.
wall_clock_exceeded or max_turns_exceeded on an in-flight story takes {stage, escalated, :budget_reported} and releases the runner's slot.
crashed releases the claim immediately over :runner_lost with the same audit entry a lease reclaim writes, without waiting for the lease.
usage_exhausted releases the claim over :runner_lost and records the release as not counting toward the retry ceiling.
A first session_ended whose claim_epoch is not the story's current epoch is refused stale_claim_epoch and changes nothing.

test_cases.name: unknown reason refused
preconditions: runner with an accepted implement dispatch

test_cases.name: resend after a release is answered ok
expected_results: second reply ok with the row; claim released once

test_cases.name: budget kill escalates, never fails
expected_results: stage escalated, edge budget_reported; in_flight decremented

test_cases.name: crash releases before lease expiry
preconditions: story at implementing with 23h of lease left
expected_results: claim released, stage queued over runner_lost, audit entry matches a reclaim's

test_cases.name: exhaustion is not a counted attempt
expected_results: stage queued; ledger records the release as uncounted

test_cases.name: stale epoch refused
preconditions: story whose claim_epoch moved past the dispatch's
steps: push session_ended crashed with the old epoch

technical_notes: Record session_ended on the dispatch ledger (Loopctl.Runners.DispatchLedger) with a payload digest, checked before the epoch fence, as triage_verdicts.payload_digest does
Release path: a variant of reclaim_expired_claim/3 (progress.ex:1620-1650) that skips the expiry check, keeps the :runner_lost edge and audit shape, and requires the dispatch's epoch
New control-only edge {in_flight, escalated, :budget_reported} in StageMachine and the contract's stage_transitions; :budget_exceeded stays unwritten
Handled in LoopctlWeb.RunnerChannel via Loopctl.Delivery.RunnerStages; Stages remains the only writer of story_stages
non_goals: Does not mark the runner exhausted (US-44.6)
Does not decide the retry ceiling (US-44.4)
